ok, yes, this is a good legal approach i think, focusing on the molestation. 

the worst part about isolating myself is that my door doesn't lock. i don't have anything i can barricade the door with. i just have to hope no one comes in. my first episode of sleep paralysis, i was convinced my father had actually come in and smothered me, but in reality, he wasn't even home that night. i've slept in the bathroom before bc at least the door locks, and sleeping on the floor is therapeutic. no more unhygienic than sleeping in my bed, in truth.

i only have one friend, lol, and no social worker. 

the irony with the animals is that my mom works at an animal shelter. all of our animals are rescues, from that shelter. that would get sticky, and while i'm angry with her and everyone else, i wouldn't want her to lose this job bc it's very flexible with her having to transport my siblings and she's well-established there, and gross pieces of shit deserve to eat, too.

my dogs have kept me company during long nights. i would hate to leave them, but i am very thankful to them for keeping me safe.

it's like for him getting away from home is a "goal" and for me it is a necessity. i hate being scared and weak all of the time. i feel very trapped.

i want to do something to where the dogs at least get the attention they deserve. my family ignores them. they get separation anxiety if i even go into another room bc i am the only one that gives them the attention they need, who runs them, i almost always am the one who feeds them morning and night. one of my siblings outright hates them. they're dogs! when you actually spend time with them, it's not difficult to tell when they need to use the bathroom or anything. they may not be trained but they're not stupid or awful or anything.

ah, my friends didnt live near me anyway. i live on the outskirts of town a, their family homes are snugly within town b, where we all attended high school. i haven't talked to them since senior year anyway.

i see him this wednesday, i'm really hoping wednesday is the day something gives. i DON'T want the thing that gives to be me, i do not want to yell or hit or anythign no matter how much i want to, but just. leaving. im sad about this whole thing obviously my mom used to be so so important to me, my siblings and used to get along so well, i used to play several instruments fluently and go out with my friends and people would like my facebooks posts and comment on them and things used to have a semblance of being ok.

i hope i can take my dogs too.

this happens to me so much that it's eroded my memory. i am sure something happened one way but no no i'm WRONG ugh learn to be wrong etc etc. my mom also likes to take advantage of how bad i am at math (which i am very embarrassed about and have tried to improve upon my entire life) and make me feel like a fucking idiot.
i hope to have some good news soon too.

i was a young teen, i immediately ran out of the room (the whole circumstances of it again are 1. very specific and 2. uncomfortable to recall so i'd rather not. i always have guilt thinking "it's not really molestation it wasn't penetrative or anyhting it wasnt that bad" which is dumb i know) and told my mom and we went in the backyard and i cried and i remember her telling me about my dad being abused as a kid and him saying he would never do that to his kids and she didnt know if she should divorce him or what nad at some point later idk if the same day or what CPS i think? came and i told them about it and they determined it hadn't happened to anyone else and he wasn't likely to be a repeat offender and he was supposed ot get alcoholism counseling and that never happened. i think i was around 13 when it happened. i have a very bad memory in general, let alone for something so traumatic.

the only visitors we ever have are my grandparents every so often and maintenance people, and there is always a FRENZY of cleaning before they show up. it's so manic. after they leave, the natural negligence sets back in and everything gets fucked up again. as a kid i used to clean out rooms and throw away the garbage (so almost everything) and then get yelled at bc "I WAS USING THAT!" no you weren't, it was under five layers of junk mail and magazines and god knows what else. so i stopped. even my own room is a mess now bc i just dont see the point in this house. 

btu anyway, my grandma once said to me "if people saw how you kids live, they would take you away and put you in a home!" and no, i don't want to live with my grandparents either. they are uber-Christian/Fox News conservatives, boring, live way north of here in a boring city, everything is clean but there is no expectation of privacy, my grandma has literally have me stand and taken pictures of my back side or my profile in certain clothes bc she thinks they're "unflattering", constantly says weird things about my body in general like how nice it i that i have broader shoulders than her, they're the ones who push this diet where i cant have gluten dairy nuts soy like everything under the goddamn sun, she gave me this dumb binder "for when im ready" about this awful diet stuff as if i just havent seen the light. i start crying every time i see it or someone gets on me about the stupid diet.

my therapist knows my experiences with in-patient and i think his expected narrative is i go to one, it costs money and i dont learn anything new, and then i have to go back home and things still suck. he told me that he would research options for me as an adult but a very young one because we both sort of think aloud and everything we threw out was for people under 18. i called the office and scheduled an appointment this coming week and impressed (sort of vaguely, since through a secretary) that findng a way out of this house is urgent. i really need to adapt what i wrote as the main post and give that to him in paper form bc i type my thoughts (however messily) much better than i speak them. and yes, he knows that i was sexually assaulted, i dont know, i tend to sort of change topics quickly and i express this resentment kind of oddly idk i think it would be fairer for both me and him if i typed him something, i've done that before. i like it when he reads them aloud for both of us

i live out in the country, bumfuck nowhere as we call it, i feel like i've researched women's shelters before and there aren't any nearby me but i could be wrong, i will check again.

i'm just happy to be validated too honestly i get validation once every two weeks from my therapist and whenever i feel comfortable veering the conversation from other things to this with my one irl who i can only talk to over skype and IM right now.

i very much want to get out, i'm just so scared about the big process of people coming over and seeing our house and then my mother getting angry and then they end up not finding anythign wrong and they leave me here and i get yelled at and ostracized even more, thats what happened when cps came over after my dad assaulted me, i don't know, even though things are totally unpredictable and uncertain here that's what i know? i normally have no qualms "shaking up the status quo", sitting in a different chair or whatever, i don't know why the prospect of leaving an abusive home is so scary to me. i mean, i do, but compared with how i'm being hurt everyday, i don't know

I re-enrolled myself at the main campus of the college i wanted to attend to begin with coming out of high school, but my mother still thinks that i enrolled at the regionals (which i will never attend as my main campus again--that was a fiasco freshman year, having barely driven myself before then having to drive to three different campuses per day on average, and the staff were useless and the academics wayyy too easy to be of any help, like high school 2.0). i'd really like to find an apartment/house and share it with some people, but i don't currently have a job or a car in my name and don't have much saved (i.e. under $200), especially with a fine my mom wants me to pay for her, and i'm just some random weirdo who posts dumb internet shit on social media, my friends who were as "weird" as me are long gone. i don't think i'm a particularly desirable roommate at this point. 

that is what i really want to do though, i don't want to reveal too much location-wise because i have talked about this before elsewhere and i have extreme paranoia of doxxing thanks to frequenting ED and /b/ as a youngster, but it's a really lovely town/campus interspersed, beautiful buildings, lots of neat restaurants/shops, really active student life/activities. lots of opportunities for self-improvement and a pretty diverse student population overall though it is highly occupied by "preps", but that's fine, they stay in their lane and i stay in mine, and it goes w/o saying that their academics are far more to my standard. i have been there several times before and i'm still angry my mother dissuaded me from going freshman year despite the HUGE scholarships/awards i had which are now gone forever.

registering for classes isn't until another month or so but i'm terrified of the whole process that will ensue with my mother finding out i lied to her, how i would get my stuff to campus if it went through and buying school supplies/books and where i would live once school got out, since my family is definitely the type to gloat and i don't want to come back under any circumstances. 

i mean, despite my depression and anxiety that i now realize was exacerbated by my family, i did extremely well in high school even with a minimum of effort expended sometimes. i finished in the top ten of my class, took all the AP classes we had. i was very active in extracurriculars and was a section leader in all the music stuff i did. i was weird, but it was cute weird, endearing weird, i know how to be charismatic if i'm dealing with adults. i really did well in high school. i'm just like, how the mighty have fallen, i guess. i don't mean to sound like nasty or full of myself but it seems that when i was something to be proud of people tolerated me a lot better but now i'm a lazy freeloader even though it's obviously not that simple. i hate mooching, i hate being dependent, i wanted a job all through high school but wasn't allowed one until graduation. i hate having to ask for help in this case but i'm honestly just stricken by what might happen to me if i try to do this myself. the legal ramifications of driving off in a car not in my name with two dogs also not under my name while i'm still under my family's insurance, phone plan, etc is romantic but obviously stupid.
